From today, Runna subscribers can use the newly launched "Adapt for Heat" feature, which automatically adjusts pace targets based on local temperature and humidity. Details are as follows.

Runna Launches Training Tool to Help Runners Cope with Hot Weather

The personal running coach app Runna announced three updates today, aimed at providing users with comprehensive support — from training in hot weather to post-race recovery — covering every aspect of the training cycle.

The "Adapt for Heat" feature officially launched today, helping users identify cooler running times and recommending adjusted pace targets based on felt-like temperature, training duration, and specific sessions.

The "Adapt for Heat" feature comes with colour-coded hourly weather forecasts, allowing users to instantly identify the best times for running and plan their training accordingly.

Runna shares the following about this new feature:

Runna also announced the relaunch of its "Post-Race Recovery Plan" feature — whenever a user starts a training plan for a 5km to 50km race, the system automatically creates a recovery plan for them. Runna Head Coach and former Olympian Steph Kessell said these plans are designed by professional coaches to help runners "reduce the risk of overtraining or injury."

Finally, the platform announced that the new feature "Upcoming Plans" will launch in August. Users can pre-arrange multiple training plans and seamlessly transition to the next plan upon completion, further simplifying long-term training management.

Runna outlines the benefits of "Upcoming Plans" as follows:

Plan your entire year of training in minutes: Runners can stack multiple races, transition goals, and training phases for a clear year-at-a-glance overview. Zero admin between plans: No need to rebuild or start from scratch — preferred training schedules, predicted finish times, and current fitness levels automatically carry over from the end of one plan to the start of the next. Flexible control: Every plan can be edited, swapped, or deleted at any time, giving runners complete control of their training experience. Built for progress: Every plan is designed by Runna's senior coaches based on proven training principles, helping runners continuously improve, recover fully, and be in peak condition on race day.
